claim: QA round 22 N-1 tail (2026-11-07): inbound-headers.ts parseSender attributes to nobody when the From, after unfolding, holds a control character (CRLF or NUL injection), uses group syntax or a source route (':' or ';' outside quotes), puts a bare address after the angle-addr, or nests a comment, and it requires addressparser's address to equal the one the header's shape holds. The Python EmailParsingAgent (_extract_email -> sender_address) applies the same rule, and the prospect and sender-reputation domainOf readers delegate to senderDomain: none of those three files still carries the first-<...> regex. inbound-headers.spec.ts and tests/test_email_sender_attribution.py run the same case table.
